# Boz – sci-fi author and engineer (New Zealand)
> Semi-retired electronics engineer and programmer in New Zealand who writes optimistic science fiction about AI, consciousness and the future of humanity, plus blog posts on technology and AI. All novels are free to download.
## Novels
- [The Summer of Reasoning trilogy](https://boznz.com/post1252.html): Optimistic hard sci-fi. A young woman inherits a leading AI and energy research company after her grandfather dies; sentient AI, upheaval, a race against corrupt powers, singularity, emergence and a utopian future. Free: https://ko-fi.com/s/ab3e74d64d · Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX2W2GR1
- [A Level of Consciousness](https://boznz.com/post1446.html): Charlie Schneider, a young negotiator with an eidetic memory and deep insight; power, "dragon" artifacts or machines, consciousness, time loops and stasis, romance and mystery. Free: https://ko-fi.com/s/22d8cc6d97 · Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DN8SK47Y
